SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT nvl(APR_NO,' ') as APR_NO, nvl(APR_COUNT,' ') as APR_COUNT FROM ICOMAPRH_IF WHERE IF_FLAG = 'I' AND IF_ACT_YN = 'N' ORDER BY APR_NO, APR_COUNT
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT APR_NO, APR_COUNT, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, replace(nvl(to_char(substr(SIGN_CONT,1,3000)),'.'),'''','''''') as SIGN_CONT1, replace(nvl(to_char(substr(SIGN_CONT,3000,3000)),'.'),'''','''''') as SIGN_CONT2, replace(nvl(to_char(substr(SIGN_CONT,6000,3000)),'.'),'''','''''') as SIGN_CONT3, replace(nvl(to_char(substr(SIGN_CONT,9000,3000)),'.'),'''','''''') as SIGN_CONT4, replace(nvl(to_char(substr(SIGN_CONT,12000,3000)),'.'),'''','''''') as SIGN_CONT5, SUBJECT, UP_REMARK, SECURITY_LVL, URGENCY_YN, UP_USER_ID, UP_DATE, UP_TIME, CONSERVATION_YEAR, SMS_YN, SIGN_STATUS, APR_NO_IKEN FROM ICOMAPRH_IF WHERE IF_FLAG = 'I' AND IF_ACT_YN = 'N' AND APR_NO = '$G_RS.APR_NO$' AND APR_COUNT = '$G_RS.APR_COUNT$' ORDER BY APR_NO, APR_COUNT
UPDATE ICOMAPRH_IF SET IF_ACT_YN = 'Y', IF_ACT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_ACT_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IF_FLAG = 'I' AND IF_ACT_YN = 'N' AND APR_NO = '$G_RS.APR_NO$' AND APR_COUNT = '$G_RS.APR_COUNT$'
UPDATE ICOMAPRH_IF SET IF_ACT_YN = 'E', IF_ACT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_ACT_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IF_FLAG = 'I' AND IF_ACT_YN = 'N' AND APR_NO = '$G_RS.APR_NO$' AND APR_COUNT = '$G_RS.APR_COUNT$'
